name: 68107 · Omaha, NE
findings: ZIP 68107 (Omaha) has 69 nonprofit organizations. 33 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 27 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (23% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 68107 (Omaha) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 68107 (Omaha) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.0 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 27 organizations here; 22% of all organizations here have no identified type.
